title: Detection limits for lunar water ice in Chandrayaan-2 DFSAR compact-polarimetric data: analysis code and verification gates
description:
Code, derived artifacts and verification gates for a study of the detection limits of a CPR-based lunar water-ice criterion applied to a single Chandrayaan-2 DFSAR L-band pass over the lunar south pole.

This record contains no Chandrayaan-2 or LOLA data. The ISRO products remain the property of ISRO and are obtained from PRADAN under ISRO's terms; the LOLA products come from the NASA PDS. docs/data_provenance.json records which files the analysis read, with SHA-256, so the same products can be obtained and confirmed byte-for-byte without this record distributing them. See DATA.md.
